summary: Doctor Dashboard module testing completed successfully. All doctorDashboard components render correctly, KPI Period Selector works with all period options (7D/30D/90D/Custom), and proper error/loading/empty states are displayed.

6_clinical_documents.details: Clinical Documents section renders with Casesheets and Prescriptions buttons.

9_typescript_compilation.details: No TypeScript errors in doctorDashboard module files. Pre-existing errors in other modules unrelated to this feature.

10_metro_bundling.details: Metro bundler successfully compiles doctorDashboard module after cache clear. Initial cache issue resolved.

critical_code_review_comments: Good: doctorDashboard module follows clean architecture pattern (data/domain/presentation layers)
